faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Where is your office if I need a salon interior designer in Pitampura?

Our head office is at Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, so meetings, material reviews and site visits for salons in North and West Delhi are easy to arrange.

Can you design a salon in a market or mall unit?

Yes. Market shops and mall units have fixed shapes and service points. We plan stations, wash areas and storage around them so the salon still flows well.

How do you plan for a busy weekend crowd?

We size the waiting area, add enough stations and plan staff routes so the salon handles peak hours without clients feeling crowded.

What does a salon interior designer handle besides looks?

Plumbing for wash basins, electrical load for dryers and tools, ventilation for chemical services and lighting at mirrors are all planned along with the design.
